caption: A flat stone is thrown sideways low over a calm lake, and it skips across the surface several times before sinking.

sa.check: A flat stone is thrown low over a lake.
It skips several times rather than once.
The lake is calm before the stone arrives.
The skipping comes first and the sinking follows.

pc.expect: Each hop is shorter and lower than the one before, all along one line.
pc.fail: A hop is higher or longer than the one before it; or the stone turns sharply between hops; or it comes back toward the thrower.

pc.expect: Between hops the stone comes down to the water, and at the end it goes under and stays under.
pc.fail: The stone floats on the surface; or it rises after a hop and keeps rising; or it comes back up after sinking.

pc.expect: Each touch leaves a splash and a ring of ripples spreading outward.
pc.fail: The stone touches the water and leaves no mark; or ripples appear where the stone never touched; or the ripples run inward.

pc.expect: The splashes fall back and settle, and the stone stays a rigid flat stone.
pc.fail: A splash hangs in the air; or the water surface stays rigid like glass under the stone; or the stone bends.

pc.expect: One stone is thrown and nothing else appears on the water.
pc.fail: The stone vanishes in mid-air or a second one appears; or it turns into another object; or it passes through the water without a splash and reappears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The stone, the lake's colour and the far shore stay the same.
pc.fail: The stone changes colour or size in flight; or the lake changes colour between frames; or the far shore rearranges.
